events.summary: One thing people don't often see about indie development is that making the game is only part of the job.At first, we were handling the art direction and narrative by ourselves. Fortunately, Damian – a great artist and close friend – joined the project. events.title: Devlog #4 Why Poker is the Ultimate Language of the Underworld
events.summary: Let's talk about why we chose poker as the heart of Golden Caravan. Sure, we could have made a standard fantasy deckbuilder where you throw fireballs or swing swords. But let's be honest - you can't exactly sit across a smoky table from a mob boss, look him dead in the eyes, and threaten him with a magic wand. It just doesn't fit the suit.
